_about: Edge weight model (time t, CO2 c) used by scripts/04_edge_weights.py. Speeds, peak factors and signal delays are ASSUMPTIONS to be calibrated against Google Maps (data/validation). Energy curves come from EMEP/EEA.
_peak_hours_about: API: a departure time inside one of these windows uses the 'peak' weights, otherwise 'offpeak'.

motorcycle_petrol.label: Xe máy xăng (4 thì <250 cc, Euro 2 = mức 2 VN)

energy.source: EMEP/EEA Guidebook 2023 (v2026), 1.A.3.b.i-iv Appendix 4, HOT_EMISSIONS_PARAMETERS: L-Category / Petrol / Motorcycles 4-stroke <250 cm3 / Euro 2 / EC
energy.co2_source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Vol.2 Table 3.2.1, motor gasoline 69 300 kg CO2/TJ

car_petrol.label: Ô tô xăng hạng nhỏ (Small, Euro 5 PFI = mức 5 VN)

energy.source: EMEP/EEA Guidebook 2023 (v2026), 1.A.3.b.i-iv Appendix 4, HOT_EMISSIONS_PARAMETERS: Passenger Cars / Petrol / Small / Euro 5 / PFI / EC
energy.co2_source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Vol.2 Table 3.2.1, motor gasoline 69 300 kg CO2/TJ

energy.wh_source: ASSUMPTION: ~17 Wh/km from a 3.5 kWh / ~200 km scooter spec, +30% real-world, +15% charging loss. Verify.
energy.grid_source: Vietnam grid emission factor 2023 (Cục Biến đổi khí hậu, Bộ TN&MT). Check for a newer official value.

_speeds_about: Off-peak running speed (km/h) per highway class, i.e. typical HCMC inner-city speed outside rush hour, NOT free-flow. Capped by OSM maxspeed when tagged. Peak speed = off-peak x peak_factor.
_signal_about: Mean waiting time (s) added per traffic-signal node passed on an edge.
